name: wjr-video-01
description: WJR Infogames — Instagram Reels showreel (9:16, 15s, 120 BPM, music + SFX) built with HyperFrames (HTML + GSAP -> MP4).

scripts.render:placeholder: node scripts/build.mjs && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.97 render --quality draft --output out/video-01-placeholder.mp4
scripts.render:draft: node scripts/build.mjs && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.97 render --quality draft --strict-variables --variables-file build/variables.json --output out/video-01-draft.raw.mp4 && bash scripts/master.sh out/video-01-draft.raw.mp4 out/video-01-draft.mp4
scripts.render: node scripts/build.mjs && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.97 render --quality delivery --strict-variables --variables-file build/variables.json --output out/video-01.raw.mp4 && bash scripts/master.sh out/video-01.raw.mp4 out/video-01.mp4
scripts.loudness: ffmpeg -hide_banner -nostats -i out/video-01.mp4 -af ebur128=peak=true -f null - 2>&1 | grep -A12 Summary
scripts.preview: ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/video-01.mp4 -vf scale=720:1280:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 25 -maxrate 3M -bufsize 6M -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy -movflags +faststart preview/video-01-preview-720p.mp4
